freeze_rule: Frozen together with COLLECT_PREREG_DRAFT.json (owner decision 10). DeepSeek fills every VM-fill marker on the collection VM (read-only commands listed in fill_commands), then the freeze commit sets status FROZEN here and in the prereg and writes the prereg sha256 into prereg.sha256. scripts/run_pairact_collect.py --mode training refuses a manifest that is not FROZEN, still contains a VM-fill marker, or whose prereg sha256 / collector source sha / episode template sha256 / batch size differ from the run. The manifest sha256 is written into the ledger header.
